## Overview Add pipeline parallelism to `vllm bench forward`, measuring a microbatch's full-pipeline forward latency under steady-state load from identical microbatches. Builds on the merged PCP support in #63613. ## Claims - Includes PP transfers and waits between the first stage's forward start and the last stage's forward completion; excludes pipeline fill/drain, input preparation before the forward, and sampling. - Captures each stage's forward in a CUDA graph and streams matching microbatches without a per-step host barrier. Reports stage timelines and estimated cross-rank clock uncertainty. - Adds rendered CLI documentation and a two-GPU CLI/profiler regression test wired into the existing distributed CI job. ## Validation Full 93-layer Kimi K3 with dummy MXFP4 weights on **4 nodes × 4 GB200 GPUs**. Balanced routing, 8,192 query tokens per microbatch, EP enabled. PP2 uses TP8/EP8; PP4 uses TP4/EP4. Kimi currently disables SP with PP. Median full-pipeline GPU latency (ms): | PP | Prefill | TRT-LLM bench | TRT-LLM serving | MegaMoE bench | MegaMoE serving | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 2 | 8 × 1K | 338.3 | 339.3 | 525.4 | 525.8 | | 2 | 1 × 8K | 357.1 | 357.9 | 517.6 | 518.1 | | 4 | 8 × 1K | 490.7 | 491.6 | 645.7 | 646.9 | | 4 | 1 × 8K | 507.3 | 505.5 | 637.8 | 637.2 | Serving measurements match request IDs across stages and use the same first/last GPU-event boundaries; these are not TTFT or Prometheus prefill histogram values. Serving uses piecewise graphs. All differences are within 0.35%. Benchmark-only KV restoration is outside stage compute timing but can affect pipeline cadence. Each benchmark case has 100 measured microbatches (5 × 20), trimming 4 × PP microbatches at each end. Final-run sample-median spread was below 1%; estimated cross-rank clock uncertainty was about 0.18–0.21 ms. All intermediate and final benchmark outputs were finite and matched the eager pipeline reference exactly. These dummy-weight checks validate execution and timing, not model quality. Both MoE backends use MXFP8 × MXFP4. MegaMoE's additional cost here includes replicated token dispatch with SP disabled; this PR does not change the model or MoE implementation.
Commands and regression evidence Full CLI suite before the final aggregation/profiling cleanup: ```bash .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_forward_cli.py -v # 9 passed .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files \ .buildkite/test_areas/distributed.yaml docs/cli/README.md docs/benchmarking/cli.md \ tests/benchmarks/test_forward_cli.py vllm/benchmarks/forward/main.py \ vllm/benchmarks/forward/pipeline.py # All applicable hooks passed ``` After the cleanup, reran the real two-GPU CLI/profiler test: ```bash .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_forward_cli.py::test_bench_forward_pipeline -v # 1 passed ``` The CPU aggregation reproduces all 100 saved latency samples exactly for each of the eight Kimi/backend/layout/shape cases. Final pre-commit checks also pass. The cleanup removes a redundant GPU reduction after gathering timelines, skips clock calibration and timing events in the profiling pass, and removes duplicate checks; the timed transfers and graph replay order are unchanged. Before the implementation, the new test was copied into an isolated worktree at `dbbb4f73de` (PCP branch tip) and run there with the same environment: ```bash PYTHONPATH=/tmp/vllm-forward-pp-base \ /home/woosuk/workspace/vllm/.venv/bin/python -m pytest \ tests/benchmarks/test_forward_cli.py::test_bench_forward_pipeline -v # FAILED: Value error, Model Runner V2 does not yet support: # pipeline parallelism with external_launcher ``` Benchmark command, run on each node (set `PP=2` or `4`, and the torchrun rendezvous variables): ```bash VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP=skip .venv/bin/torchrun \ --nnodes=4 --nproc-per-node=4 --node-rank="$NODE_RANK" \ --master-addr="$MASTER_ADDR" --master-port=29641 \ -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench forward \ --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --trust-remote-code --load-format dummy \ --pipeline-parallel-size "$PP" --tensor-parallel-size "$((16 / PP))" \ --enable-expert-parallel --max-model-len 9216 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --max-num-seqs 8 \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --kernel-config.enable_flashinfer_autotune false \ --routing balanced --kv-len-jitter 0 \ --case 'prefill8x1k=8*1024' --case prefill1x8k=8192 \ --iters 20 --samples 5 --output-json results.json ``` For MegaMoE, add `--moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe`. Model config/tokenizer revision: `f831ab66814297da540d832a5235f8e904f29d06`. Serving used the same layouts, model, routing fixture and input tokens, with prefix caching and FlashInfer autotuning disabled, `max_num_batched_tokens=8192`, `max_num_seqs=16*PP`, and `{"mode":0,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[8192]}`. A diagnostic worker recorded CUDA events around real stage forwards, without per-step synchronization. The client sent 100 groups of eight 1K requests, then 100 8K requests, all with one output token; analysis selected exact-shape microbatches and discarded fill/drain. Backend class and precision were checked on all 16 ranks for MegaMoE.
## Details The implementation is isolated to the benchmark. A benchmark-specific external-launcher executor enables stage loading; the benchmark drives the runners directly, without serving schedulers or sampling broadcasts. It reuses runner input preparation, forward context, KV-state handling, and PP/TP transfer conventions. Cross-device CUDA events cannot be subtracted directly. Pre/post calibration correlates each GPU's timeline to rank zero's monotonic clock using CPU ping-pong and host/GPU event bracketing. The benchmark reports the earliest first-stage TP start to latest last-stage TP completion for each microbatch, with the calibration uncertainty retained in JSON. This adds code compared with timing isolated stages, but is needed to measure pipeline traversal while other stages remain occupied. The full-model validation covers prefill with PP+TP+EP. Decode and combinations with PCP/DCP are not covered by these full-model runs. No serving/model code or non-PP benchmark behavior is changed. Duplicate check: searched open PRs for `"bench forward"`, pipeline benchmarking, PCP/PP benchmarking, and references to #63613. No open PR implements this feature. #62300 fixes profiling in the existing forward path and is separate from PP support. AI assistance was used for implementation, validation, and this description. Human review of the final diff remains required before marking the draft ready. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Pipeline forwards with identical microbatches and no per-step host barrier."""
+
+import gzip
+import json
+import time
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.benchmarks.forward.capture import ForwardBench, _compare, write_input_ids
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    get_pp_group,
+    get_tp_group,
+    get_world_group,
+    graph_capture,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, override_forward_context
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+from vllm.v1.executor.uniproc_executor import ExecutorWithExternalLauncher
+
+
+class ForwardPipelineExecutor(ExecutorWithExternalLauncher):
+    """Load one stage per torchrun process; PipelineBench drives execution.
+
+    Serving's external launcher requires sampling broadcasts across PP stages.
+    The forward benchmark has no sampling or independent schedulers to sync.
+    """
+
+    supports_pp = True
+
+    def execute_model(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("ForwardPipelineExecutor requires PipelineBench")
+
+
+def _tensors(output: Any) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    if isinstance(output, IntermediateTensors):
+        return output.tensors
+    if isinstance(output, tuple):
+        output = output[0]
+    return {"hidden_states": output}
+
+
+class PipelineClock:
+    """Correlate local GPU events with rank zero's monotonic clock.
+
+    CPU ping-pong bounds clock-offset error without assuming synchronized node
+    clocks. An idle-GPU event is bracketed on the host to correlate GPU time.
+    Both bounds are retained alongside the reported latency.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, trials: int = 20):
+        world = get_world_group()
+        group = world.cpu_group
+        offsets = [(0.0, 0.0)] * world.world_size
+        message = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64)
+        for peer in range(1, world.world_size):
+            candidates = []
+            for _ in range(trials):
+                if world.rank == 0:
+                    begin = time.perf_counter_ns()
+                    dist.send(message, peer, group=group)
+                    dist.recv(message, peer, group=group)
+                    end = time.perf_counter_ns()
+                    candidates.append(((begin + end) / 2 - message.item(), end - begin))
+                elif world.rank == peer:
+                    dist.recv(message, 0, group=group)
+                    message[0] = time.perf_counter_ns()
+                    dist.send(message, 0, group=group)
+            if world.rank == 0:
+                offset, rtt = min(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1])
+                offsets[peer] = (offset / 1000, rtt / 2000)
+        values = [offsets]
+        dist.broadcast_object_list(values, src=0, group=group)
+        offset_us, uncertainty_us = values[0][world.rank]
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        anchors = []
+        for _ in range(trials):
+            event = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+            begin = time.perf_counter_ns()
+            event.record()
+            event.synchronize()
+            end = time.perf_counter_ns()
+            anchors.append((end - begin, (begin + end) / 2000, event))
+        width, midpoint, self.anchor = min(anchors, key=lambda x: x[0])
+        self.origin_us = midpoint + offset_us
+        self.uncertainty_us = uncertainty_us + width / 2000
+
+    def timestamp(self, event: torch.cuda.Event, end: "PipelineClock") -> float:
+        fraction = self.anchor.elapsed_time(event) / self.anchor.elapsed_time(
+            end.anchor
+        )
+        return self.origin_us + fraction * (end.origin_us - self.origin_us)
+
+
+class PipelineBench(ForwardBench):
+    """Capture each stage, then stream matching microbatches through the stages."""
+
+    def run(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        runner, model = self.runner, self.runner.model
+        pp = get_pp_group()
+        prepare = runner.prepare_inputs
+        self._model_forward = model.forward
+
+        def prepare_and_check(*args, **kwargs):
+            batch = prepare(*args, **kwargs)
+            self._input_batch = batch
+            self._check_batch(
+                runner.pcp_manager.global_batch if runner.pcp_manager else batch
+            )
+            self.result.update(
+                num_local_tokens=batch.num_tokens,
+                num_tokens_after_padding=batch.num_tokens_after_padding,
+                batch_order=batch.req_ids,
+                pp_rank=pp.rank_in_group,
+            )
+            return batch
+
+        runner.prepare_inputs = prepare_and_check
+        model.forward = self._prepare_stage
+        try:
+            runner.execute_model(
+                self.batch.scheduler_output,
+                intermediate_tensors=runner.intermediate_tensors,
+            )
+        finally:
+            del runner.prepare_inputs, model.forward
+            runner.execute_model_state = None
+        self._capture_stage()
+        self._stream()
+        self._stream(profile=True)
+        return self.result
+
+    def _prepare_stage(self, **inputs):
+        pp = get_pp_group()
+        write_input_ids(self.batch, self._input_batch, inputs["input_ids"])
+        self.input_tensors = inputs["intermediate_tensors"]
+        if not pp.is_first_rank:
+            received = pp.recv_tensor_dict(all_gather_group=get_tp_group())
+            assert received is not None
+            for key, tensor in self.input_tensors.tensors.items():
+                tensor.copy_(received[key])
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        saved = dict(vars(context))
+
+        def forward():
+            for name, value in saved.items():
+                setattr(context, name, value)
+            with override_forward_context(context):
+                return self._model_forward(**inputs)
+
+        self._run_model = forward
+        self.snapshots = [(view, view.clone()) for view in self.state_views]
+        self.input_snapshots = (
+            {k: v.clone() for k, v in self.input_tensors.tensors.items()}
+            if self.input_tensors is not None
+            else {}
+        )
+        output = forward()
+        self.reference = {k: v.clone() for k, v in _tensors(output).items()}
+        if not pp.is_last_rank:
+            pp.send_tensor_dict(_tensors(output), all_gather_group=get_tp_group())
+        return output
+
+    def _restore(self):
+        for view, snapshot in self.snapshots:
+            view.copy_(snapshot)
+
+    def _capture_stage(self):
+        with graph_capture(self.device) as capture_context:
+            for key, tensor in self.input_snapshots.items():
+                self.input_tensors.tensors[key].copy_(tensor)
+            self._restore()
+            self._run_model()
+            for key, tensor in self.input_snapshots.items():
+                self.input_tensors.tensors[key].copy_(tensor)
+            capture_context.stream.synchronize()
+            self.reset_graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(self.reset_graph, stream=capture_context.stream):
+                self._restore()
+            self.graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(self.graph, stream=capture_context.stream):
+                self.output = self._run_model()
+        for key, tensor in self.input_snapshots.items():
+            self.input_tensors.tensors[key].copy_(tensor)
+        self.reset_graph.replay()
+        self.graph.replay()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        comparisons = {
+            key: _compare(value, self.reference[key])
+            for key, value in _tensors(self.output).items()
+        }
+        self.result.update(
+            graph_vs_eager=max(comparisons.values(), key=lambda x: x["relative_rms"]),
+            intermediate_graph_vs_eager=comparisons,
+            state_reset_bytes=sum(
+                v.numel() * v.element_size() for v in self.state_views
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def _stream(self, profile: bool = False):
+        pp, world = get_pp_group(), get_world_group()
+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        received = []
+        if not pp.is_first_rank:
+            for key, tensor in self.input_tensors.tensors.items():
+                if not tensor.numel():
+                    continue
+                sharded = pp._should_use_all_gather(key, tensor.numel(), tp, None)
+                buffer = (
+                    torch.empty_like(tensor.reshape(tp.world_size, -1)[0])
+                    if sharded
+                    else tensor
+                )
+                received.append((tensor, buffer, sharded))
+        sent = []
+        if not pp.is_last_rank:
+            for key, tensor in _tensors(self.output).items():
+                if tensor.numel():
+                    if pp._should_use_all_gather(key, tensor.numel(), tp, None):
+                        tensor = tensor.reshape(tp.world_size, -1)[tp.rank_in_group]
+                    sent.append(tensor)
+        clock = None if profile else PipelineClock()
+        # Warmup and drain are excluded by microbatch ID, not by local stage time.
+        margin = 4 * pp.world_size
+        count = 3 if profile else self.iters * self.samples
+        starts, ends = [], []
+        dist.barrier(group=world.cpu_group)
+        torch_profile = profile and self.profile_prefix is not None
+        profiler = (
+            torch.profiler.profile(
+                activities=[
+                    torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU,
+                    torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA,
+                ]
+            )
+            if torch_profile
+            else nullcontext()
+        )
+        if profile and not torch_profile:
+            torch.cuda.profiler.start()
+        scope = (
+            torch.cuda.nvtx.range(f"forward/{self.name}") if profile else nullcontext()
+        )
+        with profiler as prof, scope:
+            for _ in range(count + 2 * margin):
+                self.reset_graph.replay()
+                for tensor, buffer, sharded in received:
+                    dist.irecv(
+                        buffer,
+                        pp.ranks[pp.rank_in_group - 1],
+                        group=pp.device_group,
+                    ).wait()
+                    if sharded:
+                        tensor.copy_(tp.all_gather(buffer, dim=0).reshape(tensor.shape))
+                if not profile:
+                    start, end = (
+                        torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(2)
+                    )
+                    start.record()
+                self.graph.replay()
+                if not profile:
+                    end.record()
+                    starts.append(start)
+                    ends.append(end)
+                for tensor in sent:
+                    dist.isend(
+                        tensor,
+                        pp.ranks[pp.rank_in_group + 1],
+                        group=pp.device_group,
+                    ).wait()
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        if profile and not torch_profile:
+            torch.cuda.profiler.stop()
+            return
+        if profile:
+            from vllm.benchmarks.forward.profile import summarize
+
+            assert prof is not None
+            trace = f"{self.profile_prefix}.trace.json.gz"
+            prof.export_chrome_trace(trace)
+            with gzip.open(trace, "rt") as f:
+                events = json.load(f)["traceEvents"]
+            summary = {
+                "trace": trace,
+                **summarize(events, count + 2 * margin, len(self.state_views)),
+            }
+            summary_path = f"{self.profile_prefix}.kernels.json"
+            with open(summary_path, "w") as f:
+                json.dump(summary, f, indent=1)
+            self.result["profile"] = {
+                "summary": summary_path,
+                "scope": "pipeline_stage_including_transfers",
+                "span_us": summary["span_us"],
+                "busy_us": summary["busy_us"],
+                "activities": summary["activities"],
+                "top_kernels": summary["kernels"][:10],
+            }
+            return
+        self.result["pipeline_vs_eager"] = {
+            key: _compare(value, self.reference[key])
+            for key, value in _tensors(self.output).items()
+        }
+        self.result["finite"] = all(
+            bool(t.isfinite().all()) for t in _tensors(self.output).values()
+        )
+        end_clock = PipelineClock()
+        assert clock is not None
+        local = {
+            "stage": pp.rank_in_group,
+            "dp_rank": self.runner.dp_rank,
+            "starts_us": [clock.timestamp(e, end_clock) for e in starts],
+            "ends_us": [clock.timestamp(e, end_clock) for e in ends],
+            "clock_uncertainty_us": max(clock.uncertainty_us, end_clock.uncertainty_us),
+        }
+        gathered: list[Any] = [None] * world.world_size
+        dist.all_gather_object(gathered, local, group=world.cpu_group)
+        latencies, uncertainties = [], []
+        for dp_rank in {r["dp_rank"] for r in gathered}:
+            replica = [r for r in gathered if r["dp_rank"] == dp_rank]
+            first = [r for r in replica if r["stage"] == 0]
+            last = [r for r in replica if r["stage"] == pp.world_size - 1]
+            latencies.append(
+                np.max([r["ends_us"] for r in last], axis=0)
+                - np.min([r["starts_us"] for r in first], axis=0)
+            )
+            uncertainties.append(
+                max(r["clock_uncertainty_us"] for r in first)
+                + max(r["clock_uncertainty_us"] for r in last)
+            )
+        latency = np.max(latencies, axis=0)[margin:-margin]
+        medians = np.median(latency.reshape(self.samples, self.iters), axis=1)
+        self.result.update(
+            pipeline_timeline=local,
+            pipeline_warmup_microbatches=margin,
+            clock_uncertainty_us=max(uncertainties),
+            latency_us={
+                "timer": "pipeline_correlated_gpu_events_rank_max",
+                "median": float(np.median(latency)),
+                "mean": float(latency.mean()),
+                "min": float(latency.min()),
+                "p90": float(np.percentile(latency, 90)),
+                "std": float(latency.std()),
+                "count": count,
+                "samples_us": latency.tolist(),
+                "sample_spread_pct": float(100 * np.ptp(medians) / np.median(latency)),
+            },
+        )
